criteria: Main meaning and clear concise Summary; not exact wording or exhaustive conditions. Accepted Current summaries are not renamed solely to match golden wording.

minimal_prompt_fixes: Summarize the primary contribution in a short title, not a restatement of its procedure or details.
Keep the actual action and its central subject and outcome; do not replace checking with doing or a set of distinct outcomes with a vague abstraction.

Keep a qualifier when dropping it changes the main meaning, including all-and-only boundaries. If an existing Summary already does this clearly, retain it; do not change wording just to match an older source.
